 Thanh Vinh • November 20, 2026 21:36 After a 1-1 draw at Allianz Arena in the 10th round of the Bundesliga, Bayern Munich sit top of the table with 21 points, level with Borussia Dortmund but with a better goal difference. Meanwhile, 1. FC Köln are in 15th place with 9 points, just above the relegation zone.

 The head-to-head record heavily favors Bayern Munich.
 Looking at the last five encounters, Bayern Munich holds a clear advantage. The home team has won 5 matches, drawn 0, and lost none against 1. FC Köln.
 Such a series of results not only reflects a gap in quality, but also gives a psychological advantage to the team playing at home, where they are accustomed to controlling the pace of the game and putting early pressure on their opponents.
 Form: Bayern Munich is consistent, 1. FC Köln is inconsistent.

 The gap in the rankings.
 The contrasting form is clearly reflected in the league table. Bayern Munich is in first place with 21 points, while 1. FC Köln is in 15th place with 9 points.
 The 12-point gap between the two teams reflects the difference in performance since the start of the season. One side is leading and maintaining a good run of results, while the other is still trying to find stability in the lower half of the table.
 The key point of the match

 Conversely, 1. FC Köln needs to find a way to maintain their composure, minimize mistakes, and make the most of the rare opportunities. After their last defeat, the visitors face the challenge of regaining confidence against an opponent they have yet to overcome in recent encounters.
 Assessment

The match at Allianz Arena is therefore expected to be an opportunity for the league leaders to further assert their dominance against an inconsistent 1. FC Köln.
